method.cross_check: Every row carries the closed-form slack alongside the Monte Carlo. They are computed by different routes: if p_full at sigma -> 0 is not 1.0 wherever slack is positive, or not 0.0 wherever slack is negative, the simulation is wrong.
method.heading_error: ASSUME: 0.5 deg of heading error per mm of sigma. A placeholder shape, not a measurement; P3 replaces it.
method.models: the placement-error DISTRIBUTION, not the robot
method.sigma_status: ASSUME — field tests P2 and P3 measure it
method.why: A time-stepped robot needs friction, odometry drift and motor response, every one of which is an unmeasured ASSUME until field tests P1-P6 run. Modelling the outcome keeps exactly one unknown.

parameters.note: A7 is open: `completely_in` may consume the contact patch or the silhouette. Both are swept rather than one being chosen.
